B5 means stop and give priority in the new Belgian Code de la voie publique.
B7 is retained only as a legacy/transition announcement of B5; it is not the stop event.
D5 is the mandatory roundabout-direction sign in the new Belgian catalogue.
F1a marks the start of a built-up area in the Belgian catalogue.
